subject: Latency Clearinghouse — demo booking & prep
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Tim Chen <tim.chen@finova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Latency Clearinghouse — demo booking & prep

Tim —

Thanks again for taking the time last week to walk through the pilot results. The next step we discussed was a short results readout + demo that brings your SEs, procurement, and security into the room so we can align on performance targets and signing criteria.

Quick proposal: 60-minute slot that includes a 20-min results summary (latency P95/P99, throughput, burst behavior), 25-min live demo of the same workload on our Dedicated profile, and 15-min open Q&A + procurement checklist.

Proposed dates/times (PT):
- Wed 9 Jun — 10:00–11:00
- Thu 10 Jun — 14:00–15:00
- Fri 11 Jun — 11:00–12:00

I've attached an agenda and a short pre-demo checklist for both your engineering and procurement teams to review. If any of these slots are tight, tell us which one you prefer and we can flex.

Attendees we recommend: your engineering lead (you or Tim), procurement (Elaine/contracting), our AE (Sergio), SE (Marissa), and security/product compliance (Karthik or Mina). We can also run the readout with a smaller group and then loop folks into the recording.

Deliverables on our side: short performance summary PDF, runbook for the demo, and SOC2 summary (we can provide the attestation snapshot during the meeting).

Next steps: pick a preferred slot, confirm procurement contact, and we'll send calendar invites + a DocuSign for the standard NDA/PO terms if procurement needs it pre-demo.

Thanks —
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-latency-agenda.pdf (PDF), pre-demo-checklist.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Tim Chen <tim.chen@finova.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finova.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Latency Clearinghouse — demo booking & prep

Sergio —

Appreciate the clear options. Two quick items from our side:
1) Procurement prefers meetings after 11am PT. Elaine (cc'd procurement) handles contracting.
2) Our security team needs to see the SOC 2 Type II report (redacted OK) and a short note on data retention before we commit a demo environment. Can you share that ahead of the call?

Of the three slots, Fri 11 Jun 11:00–12:00 PT looks best for the engineers, but I need procurement to confirm. If procurement pushes back, Thu 10 Jun 14:00–15:00 PT is our backup.

Also: if the readout is recording, please flag that up front so we can confirm with the team.

Thanks,
Tim Chen
Senior Staff Engineer, Finova
tim.chen@finova.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tim Chen <tim.chen@finova.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, procurement@finova.com
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Latency Clearinghouse — demo booking & prep

Hi Tim / Elaine —

Following up on Sergio's note. We can accommodate Fri 11 Jun 11:00–12:00 PT and will mark that as the tentative slot unless we hear otherwise from procurement.

To address the security ask up front: attaching the SOC2 summary pack (redacted) and a one-page note on how we handle KV/cache eviction and ephemeral logs when running customer workloads. Mina is copied — she'll be on the call to speak to operational controls and retention policy.

Logistics we'll cover in the meeting:
- What the P95/P99 numbers represent (same workload + tokens, warm vs cold cache)
- How Dedicated capacity affects tail latency and throughput
- Agreement checklist for procurement (SOW, billing cadence, data controls)

Action items for Finova before the call:
- Confirm procurement contact for DocuSign/invoice workflow (Elaine?)
- Share any specific test queries or traffic shape you want included in the demo (JSON or sample corpus)

We'll send a calendar invite after procurement confirms. If procurement needs a pre-demo PO or MSA, we can provide a redline-friendly DocuSign link; otherwise we can present the standard terms and move to signature afterwards.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments referenced: SOC2-summary-redacted.pdf (PDF), demo-runbook.pdf (PDF)

Subject: Re: Latency Clearinghouse — demo booking & prep

Marissa / Tim / Sergio —

Confirmed: Fri 11 Jun 11:00–12:00 PT works for procurement and engineering. Please send calendar invites and the DocuSign link for the standard MSA so procurement can queue a PO if the readout meets expectations. We do not need the full SOC2 package up front; the redacted summary is fine for now.

For the meeting please:
- Mark the invite as "Record: No" by default. If you want to record, get explicit approval from Finova prior to starting.
- Include a 5–10 minute section on billing cadence and termination/notice terms (procurement ask).

Elaine Wu
Sr. Procurements Manager, Finova
elaine.wu@finova.com
